description: Citation Audit — Bibliography in, evidence audit out: reference-verifier checks every reference (fabricated, mis-cited, retracted, corrected); the top DOI-bearing references (corrections first, then the most cited in the manuscript) get a replication-auditor pass on the sentence that cites them; when a target is contested, paper-contradictions compares it with the studies against it. The contradiction check is opt

arxivId.description: arXiv id or URL; references are read from the ar5iv HTML (.ltx_bibitem), falling back to the PDF.

bibtex.description: BibTeX/BibLaTeX text (the contents of a .bib file).

claim.description: The claim the bibliography supports; used for the replication and contradiction checks instead of the citing sentence.

identifiers.description: Bare identifiers instead of a bibliography: up to 150 DOIs (bare, doi: or doi.org URL), arXiv ids or URLs, or PMIDs (bare, PMID: or PubMed URL), mixed freely. Each is resolved and checked for retraction, correction and a published version of record.

latex.description: LaTeX source with a thebibliography environment (\bibitem) or embedded filecontents .bib; \cite commands supply citation contexts and are checked against the entries.

manuscript.description: Optional manuscript text (LaTeX or plain) that supplies citation contexts: \cite keys, [n] numbers or Author (year) citations.

pdfUrl.description: Public PDF URL. Text extraction is best-effort (Word and Google Docs exports work best).

references.description: Plain-text reference list (numbered, blank-line separated, or one per line; APA, IEEE, Vancouver, Chicago).

name: citation-audit
